assets.caption: EXHIBIT 5-19 Typical Drum Platform Arrangements - a. Horizontal Drum Platform Supports. Three horizontal drums shown side by side with different support arrangements: supported from concrete piers, supported from trunnions, and supported from grade. Top head platform supported from trunnions is annotated.

EXHIBIT 5-19 (cont.) - b. Vertical Drum Platform Supports. Vertical drum with platform extending from upper portion; annotations identify top head platform supported from trunnions, support bracket, and vessel clip.

EXHIBIT 5-19 (cont.) - c. Structure-Located Drum. Horizontal drum mounted inside a rectangular structural frame with associated piping and supports; vertical and horizontal structural members form the support framework around the drum.
EXHIBIT 5-19 (cont.) - d. Common Platform. Two horizontal drums shown side by side at the same elevation on a common platform/foundation arrangement.
